chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: We were told by Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Isa ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Bazanti, from Yahya ibn Imran, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),
regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And We granted to him Ishaq, and Ya’qoub as an addition.» He said: A child of the child is an addition.

key_terms.وُلِدَ الْوَلَدُ: the birth of a child (specifically a grandchild in this context)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'as an addition' mean in the context of Prophet Ibrahim's children?
ai.summary: In Ma'ani al-Akhbar, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interpreting the term 'nafila' in Quran 21:72 as referring specifically to the birth of a grandchild, thereby extending the divine blessing of progeny to the next generation. This exegesis highlights the spiritual and social value of multi-generational lineage in Shia tradition, framing such blessings as additional divine favors beyond immediate offspring.
